about: Reading a Query's JSON alone (ADR-0207, FN-13): what the reader refuses, in the C# core's words and at the path it names, and what it takes, written again. Transcribed from tests/ExGrid.Tests/GridViewStateJsonTests.cs and QuerySerialisationTests.cs.

cases.name: FN-13: a Query of version 0 is refused by name

refused.says: A Query of version 0 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a Query of version 2 is refused by name

refused.says: A Query of version 2 cannot be read; this reader reads version 1 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a Query that names no version is refused

refused.says: A Query names its version as a number; this reader reads version 1 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: text that is not JSON is not a Query
FN-13: an array is not a Query

refused.says: A Query is a JSON object.

cases.name: FN-13: a range no grid could ask for is refused on the way in: 0 rows at 0

refused.says: A Query's range is a run of at least one row at a position of 0 or more, and 0 rows at 0 is not (ADR-0001).

cases.name: FN-13: a range no grid could ask for is refused on the way in: 5 rows at -1

refused.says: A Query's range is a run of at least one row at a position of 0 or more, and 5 rows at -1 is not (ADR-0001).

cases.name: FN-13: a range no grid could ask for is refused on the way in: -3 rows at 0

refused.says: A Query's range is a run of at least one row at a position of 0 or more, and -3 rows at 0 is not (ADR-0001).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a start with a fraction

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $.range.start: 'start' is a whole number, and here it is the number 1.5 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a count past 32 bits

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $.range.count: 'count' is a whole number, and here it is the number 3000000000 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a count written with a point

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $.range.count: 'count' is a whole number, and here it is the number 2.0 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a range null

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $.range: 'range' is null, and it is an object (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a range missing

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $: its member 'range' is missing (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a range's count missing

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $.range: its member 'count' is missing (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a misshapen Query is refused in the form's words, at where it stands: a View State's member

refused.says: A Query cannot be read at $: it has no member 'columns' in version 1 (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a Query is read without a grid's columns, and names any column
FN-13: a Query's sort level that names no column is refused
FN-13: a Query's filter on an empty column name is refused
FN-13: a Query's operand is read as a View State's is

refused.says: The filter on 'Notional', clause 1: '1e3' is not a Decimal written in the invariant culture (ADR-0207).

cases.name: FN-13: a Query with no filter and no sort reads back as itself
FN-13: a Query at the last range a grid can ask for reads back as itself
